Distribution: Authors indicate they examine normality but seems just for affect network structure values (“We used these values [index of average change in network structure] to explore if change over time in affect network structure differed between treatment groups or between participants who relapsed versus those who remained in remission, using an ANOVA or Kruskal–Wallis test (when a Shapiro–Wilks test indicated violation of normality).” (page 5)

Note: The data extraction focuses on what the authors term ‘inertia’ and discuss in their introduction as such, namely autocorrelation. They do also examine autoregression in their network models, which are time-varying (so allowing within-person change), but the authors never associate this with the concept of inertia or even specifically discuss the results of any autoregressive parameters from these models; as such, not including these in this extraction.
